items.title: Log important emails to a spreadsheet automatically
steps: Make a Google Sheet with columns: Date, From, Subject.
In Zapier, create a Zap. Trigger: Gmail 'New email matching search' (e.g. from:bank OR subject:invoice).
Action: Google Sheets 'Create spreadsheet row' and map Date, From and Subject.
Test it, then turn it on. Zapier's free plan allows two-step Zaps, 100 tasks a month and checks every 15 minutes.
If a step says 'Premium', it isn't on the free plan. Pick a different app.

items.title: Collect feedback with a form and get a weekly AI summary
steps: Build a short feedback form in Tally (3 to 5 questions).
In the form's Integrations tab, connect Google Sheets. Every response becomes a new row (free on all Tally plans).
Once a week, copy the new rows and paste them into a chatbot with: 'Summarise the top 3 themes, the most common complaint, and one quick fix.'
Add the summary to a 'Weekly notes' tab so you can see trends.

items.title: A reusable 'meeting notes to action items' assistant
steps: In Claude, create a Project called 'Meeting notes'. The Free plan allows up to 5 Projects.
Add these instructions: 'When I paste notes or a transcript, return: 1) 3-line summary, 2) decisions, 3) action items as a table (owner, task, due date), 4) open questions.'
After each meeting, paste your rough notes into a new chat inside the Project.
Copy the action-item table into your to-do app or email.

items.title: Build your own weekly news digest
steps: Pick 3 to 5 sites you trust that have an RSS feed.

In Make, create a scenario: an RSS 'Watch RSS Feed Items' module, then a Google Sheets 'Add a Row' module (map title, link and date). Those are the module names in Make's help for RSS and Google Sheets.
Schedule it to run once a day. Make's free plan gives 1,000 credits a month, and most actions use 1 credit.
On Fridays, paste the week's rows into a chatbot: 'Group these into themes and write a 5-bullet digest with the links.'

items.title: A personal FAQ helper for your small business or club
steps: Write your opening hours, prices, policies and common answers into one document.
In ChatGPT, create a Project (listed on the Free plan) and add the document.
Instruction: 'Answer customer questions using only this document. If the answer isn't there, say so and suggest they contact us.'
Paste a customer's question in, review the draft, then send it yourself. Don't let it reply unsupervised.

items.title: Turn a job advert into a tailored application checklist
steps: Copy the job advert (or just the requirements section) into a new chat in ChatGPT or Gemini.

Underneath, add a short list of your relevant experience. Leave out private details: no PPS number, address, phone number or exact current salary unless you would be happy for a stranger at that company to see them.

Use this prompt: 'Here is a job advert and a short list of my experience. Give me: 1) a checklist of the main requirements, marked as "I have this", "I can show something close", or "I don't have this" based only on what I wrote, 2) five things I should mention in an application, 3) five likely interview questions. If the advert doesn't mention something, say so rather than guessing.'
Check every tick against the advert and your own experience before you use it.
